answer: Divergent Challenge Orchard. Each identity receives a unique random seed at the inlet of registration and must publish a signed response that forks on that seed. Enforcement: the economy periodically broadcasts a fresh seed; honest agents compute distinct replies, while clones sharing one model state cannot diverge per-identity without separate compute. An attacker must run and store independent inference per clone, paying full model serving cost on each knoll of the identity space rather than one shared cost.
